## Your theme

Paste the complete Markdown theme below. You can export it with `moodsh theme export my-theme.md`, or make it at https://moodsh.vercel.app/themes/share/.

## Author credit

Your name or handle, plus an optional public profile link.

## Preview background

Does your palette work best on a light or dark terminal? Backgrounds are not part of the theme file.

## Permission

- [ ] I created this palette or have permission to share it under the MIT license.

Submissions are reviewed before appearing in the gallery. Please do not include private information or credentials.
